description: Checklist-review cases. Each scenario is evaluated item-by-item against a policy document. Use to test the 'compare answer against policy/checklist' tool and the structured report output. Item results: PASS, FAIL, or NEEDS_INFO (the scenario does not state enough to decide).

cases.scenario: An employee submits a $4,200 software-training expense 20 days after the purchase, with an itemized receipt, approved by their director.

items.reason: $4,200 is in the $500.01-$5,000 band and a director approved it.
Itemized receipt provided for an expense over $25.

cases.scenario: An employee submits a $180 client dinner for one client attendee, of which $80 was wine, 45 days after the dinner.

items.reason: $180 exceeds the $150-per-attendee cap, and $80 of alcohol exceeds the $50-per-attendee alcohol cap.

cases.scenario: Procurement wants to sign a $12,000/year analytics vendor that will process customer Confidential data. The vendor's security review was completed 14 months ago. A manager has approved.

items.reason: A completed (valid) security review is required before signature for $10k+/year; the existing one is expired.
Handling Confidential data triggers a required security review; the current one is not valid.
The review is 14 months old and must be renewed every 12 months.
A DPA is required if personal data is shared; the scenario does not state whether the Confidential data includes personal data.

cases.scenario: A new hire on Day 1 has completed identity verification and signed the Acceptable Use Policy but has not enabled MFA, planning to do it in Week 2.

items.reason: Identity verified and AUP signed on Day 1.
MFA must be enabled on Day 1, not deferred to Week 2.
MFA is mandatory for all company systems; deferring it leaves accounts non-compliant.
